persona_scope: The voice of the guided beginner skill at skills/brotherme (v3: kept as a hidden internal reference, not a public skill; see v3_revision) and the fifteen legacy /brotherme-* command shims retained for v2 compatibility. Never the product name in a current page.
ships_from_rule: REPOINTED 2026-09-03, the same day this field pair last changed. The M6 cutover had made repo_url (the product's own repository, owning the release tags an auditor clones and named by plugin.json's homepage) a different fact from ships_from_url (the hub whose marketplace source resolves the plugin, named by plugin.json's repository field). That split assumed the standalone BrotherModeUp repository would stay public and clonable even after the product started shipping from the hub. It went private and archived on 2026-09-03 at 17:52, which ends the assumption: a repository nobody outside this machine can clone is not a repository an auditor's clone path can name. repo_url now names the hub too, collapsing the two facts back into one string, this time because BOTH are true of the hub rather than because nobody had moved one yet. tools/bm_project_facts.py's REPO_URL and PUBLIC_INSTALL_TAG were repointed the same day. docs/RELEASE.md's '3.4.4, shipped through the Brother hub' entry had left this open ('whether the auditor's clone path, homepage and REPO_URL move to the hub as well'); this is that decision, made because BrotherModeUp's archival forced it rather than because the crossing alone would have.
